psychological_meaning: Summer Green evokes feelings of freshness, growth, and tranquility. It is associated with nature, renewal, and balance, promoting a sense of calm and well-being. This color suggests harmony and connection to the earth, fostering a peaceful and rejuvenating atmosphere.
